shared_elements: upright rounded/rectangular stone slab or stele as the field
relief carving in low relief on a monolithic slab

justification: Both depict an upright slab-shaped monument carrying low-relief carving arranged vertically, but the actual content differs entirely: A shows a ship with mast, rigging, a crew row of figures and a triangular-patterned hull band, while B shows a T-headed pillar with an arm-like vertical element and a single quadruped/reptile in relief clinging to the shaft. Apart from the generic fact of a carved standing stone, no specific motif, relationship or rendering convention is shared.
